name: assignment
grammar:
// Aurora — canonical PEG grammar
// Edit this file in Lashon Studio; it is synced into language.yaml on save.

program       <- statement+
statement     <- function_def / if_stmt / while_stmt / return_stmt / print_stmt / assignment / expr_stmt
function_def  <- 'fn' IDENT '(' param_list? ')' block
block         <- '{' statement* '}'
param_list    <- IDENT (',' IDENT)*
if_stmt       <- 'if' comparison block ('else' block)?
while_stmt    <- 'while' comparison block
return_stmt   <- 'return' expr ';'
print_stmt    <- 'print' expr ';'
assignment    <- IDENT '=' expr ';'
expr_stmt     <- call ';'
comparison    <- expr ('==' / '!=' / '<=' / '>=' / '<' / '>') expr
expr          <- term (('+' / '-') term)*
term          <- factor (('*' / '/' / '%') factor)*
factor        <- call / NUMBER / STRING / boolean / IDENT / '(' expr ')'
call          <- IDENT '(' arg_list? ')'
arg_list      <- expr (',' expr)*
boolean       <- 'true' / 'false'

name: arithmetic
grammar:

print_stmt <- 'print' expr ';'

factor   <- NUMBER / STRING / IDENT / '(' expr ')'
